description: This file defines a JSON schema for the MaintenanceManager plugin API, including methods, events, data structures, and constants related to maintenance activities on set-top devices.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status about ongoing maintenance activities, including current maintenance state, last completion time, and reboot requirements.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time for maintenance.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Configures the maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out mode, affecting how updates are handled.

methods.name: startMaintenance
methods.description: Initiates maintenance activities on the device.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current persistent maintenance mode and opt-out settings.
